value: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (2023). Oil and Natural Gas Sector: Emission Standards for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review. Background Technical Support Document for the Final New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) and Emissions Guidelines (EG), 40 CFR Part 60 subpart OOOOb (NSPS) and subpart OOOOc (EG). November 2023. Research Triangle Park, NC: Office of Air Quality Planning and Standards. Docket ID No. EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-3988.

Targeted pass on the 162-page final TSD. Page numbers are printed chapter-page numbers (e.g. 2-33; attachments B-18). The final TSD only re-analyses process controllers (Ch.2), pumps (Ch.3) and associated gas (Ch.4) plus FEAST attachments; all other sources (compressors, storage vessels, fugitives, liquids unloading, completions) still rest on the December 2022 supplemental TSD (epa_2022_002) and the November 2021 proposal TSD (epa_2021_001), extracted separately. All costs 2019 USD; "tpy"/"$/ton" are US short tons (not converted; coordinator should convert x0.907185). Capacity rows are methane avoided per site per year (target ch4), the basis of the oil-and-gas control archetypes; archetype pneumatic-device_non-emitting has product m3 gas handled, so the coordinator must convert or use the per-t-CH4 rows. Loaded: controllers - zero-emission options (grid electric, solar electric, generator electric, grid instrument air, generator instrument air) for 4 of 7 model plants (small production, large production, large midstream, large T&S; medium production and small T&S omitted for volume; small midstream is identical to large production), new and existing sites: TCI as capex, gross system O&M as opex-fixed, life, 7%, methane avoided (= baseline, 100%), cost effectiveness; enhanced maintenance of intermittent controllers; routing to existing/new combustor (new sources; existing-source values in other-values). Pumps: 8 options for one production diaphragm pump, new and existing (5-pump, T&S and piston values in other-values). Associated gas: route to sales (4-inch 1/5/10 mi, 6-inch 5 mi) and flare (capital/O&M not repeated: already in epa_2023_001). Opex-fixed is gross O&M of the new system; table annual costs (capital recovery + O&M, net of avoided gas-driven costs) are in other-values. Not extracted: GHGI tables, state regulations, secondary NOx/PM tables, Ch.5 industry capex comparison, Ch.6 marginal wells, FEAST emission tables (only Table 7 % reductions in other-values). Source defects: Table 2-12 new-site Total Compressor System Cost includes capital recovery while the existing-site row does not (opex derived from components); LM new-site electricity 3,814 vs existing 7,627; Table 3-12 annual cost 26,201 vs text 25,435; Table 3-9 new-source routing-to-VRU annual 1,634 vs 869 for existing sources and in the text; text says pipe distances to 80 miles but tables stop at 50; Table 4-2 prints New Savings for Net Savings; table of contents numbering error at 4.6.
